scoring_justification: Transition enthalpy/entropy, glass transition parameters, and residual configurational entropy are recomputed from agent's raw JSON values and compared to paper-reported values with tolerances. Configurational entropy curve is verified by structural checks and endpoint agreement, which serves as a recompute of key points from the curve.

outputs.description: Transition enthalpy (kJ/mol) and entropy (J/K/mol) for the ordered‑to‑plastic phase transition.
Glass transition temperature (K) and heat capacity jump (J/K/mol) of cyanoadamantane.

Temperature dependence of the configurational entropy. When ordered by increasing temperature, the configurational entropy must exhibit a monotonic increase (non-decreasing) with a clear plateau at low temperatures below the glass transition.
Residual configurational entropy (J/K/mol) at the glass transition temperature.

output_contract.notes: The target_policy for the S_c curve uses structural audit to verify monotonic increase (non-decreasing with temperature) and plateau at low temperatures near Tg, while scalar quantities are evaluated by exact match with the paper‑reported values within appropriate tolerances.
